title: Discover Technologies. Evaluate Solutions. Build Business Connections.
subtitle: BUILDIQ offers visitors an opportunity to explore emerging technologies and identify practical solutions for residential, commercial and industrial buildings.
closingNote: Whether you are an architect, developer, consultant, contractor, system integrator, facility manager or technology buyer, BUILDIQ offers a professional environment to discover solutions for the next generation of buildings.

coreBenefits.title: Discover Smart Technologies
coreBenefits.description: Discover the latest smart home and building automation technologies alongside intelligent lighting, security and energy management solutions.

coreBenefits.title: Evaluate Products
coreBenefits.description: Compare products and technologies from multiple manufacturers and understand how connected technologies can improve building performance.

coreBenefits.title: Meet Manufacturers
coreBenefits.description: Interact directly with product specialists, R&D engineers and technology providers demonstrating live smart building systems.

coreBenefits.title: Connect with Suppliers
coreBenefits.description: Identify suitable suppliers, dealers and system integration partners across all ten intelligent building categories.

coreBenefits.title: Explore Project Solutions
coreBenefits.description: Explore solutions for ongoing and upcoming building projects across smart offices, intelligent homes and commercial infrastructure.

coreBenefits.title: Build Industry Relationships
coreBenefits.description: Develop new professional and business relationships with peers, technology innovators and infrastructure leaders.
